source.snippet: Salesforce will not download metadata for lightning components. The most obvious use-case is to search the metadata in Visual Studio code. Also, it may allow version comparisons, if you keep histories locally. Is there anyone with a known workaround? Does anyone know of a roadmap for Salesforce to fix this?

problem_statement: Salesforce developers cannot download metadata for Lightning Web Components, blocking local code search in VS Code and preventing version-diff workflows that teams rely on for audit and change management.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and admins at SMB-to-enterprise orgs using Lightning Web Components and VS Code tooling.
notes: Work context is explicit (VS Code dev environment, version comparison for team workflows). Single post but represents a class of blocker that Salesforce ISVs and consulting shops encounter regularly; tooling gaps in Salesforce ecosystem have historically supported paid AppExchange products and third-party dev tools.
